कैशव कैशव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. केशव), be-
longing to Keśava, (Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu.)

कैशिक कैशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. केश), hair-
like, fine as a hair; (अस्), m. love, passion, lust; N. of a
[]
subdivision of the Yādavas, descended from Kaiśika,
who was son of Vidarbha and brother of Kratha; (ई),
f., scil. वृत्ति, one of the four varieties of dramatic style,
the graceful style, suited especially to the passion of
love; N. of a place or river; an epithet of Durgā;
(अम्), n. a quantity of hair, a head of hair.

कैशिन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. केशिन्), connected with
Keśin Dārbhya.

कैश्य, अम्, n. (fr. केश), the whole mass of
hair, a head of hair, much or ornamented hair.

कैशोर कैशोर, अम्, n. (fr. किशोर), youth,
boyhood, from the age of ten to that of fifteen.
—कैशोरक-वयस्, अस्, n. the age or life of a youth.

कैष्किन्ध कैष्किन्ध, अस्, ई, अम्, coming
from Kiṣkindhā.
